fixed_before_acceptance: 2026-10-30, after the pilots in raw/pilot-*.jsonl and before any acceptance campaign ran
estimand: per block: candidate mean ns/op / base mean ns/op (cc_*: wall ns per operation, inverse throughput); compared as natural logs
bound: one-sided 95% Student t upper bound on the mean log ratio over the campaign's blocks, exponentiated (analyze.py)

gates.primary: pt_ea, pt_av, pt_asof: upper bound <= 1.02 for B:H in each of primary-1 and primary-2, in both envelope and release
gates.control: B:B in each primary campaign and profile: lower bound >= 0.98 and upper bound <= 1.02 for every family, else the campaign is inconclusive
gates.results: every block's result digests equal between base and candidate; any mismatch fails
gates.cold: every cold observation's resident page count after eviction is 0, else the cold category is outstanding

block_count_basis: pilot log-ratio sd: primary envelope <= 0.024, release <= 0.060 (16 blocks); secondary <= 0.056; cold <= 0.021; concurrency <= 0.096; wasi <= 0.055; browser <= 0.020. Primary: 128 blocks give a one-sided 95% half-width of 1.657*0.060/sqrt(128) = 0.0088 at the worst release sd, so the B:B control can resolve +-2%. Others: 1.68*0.096/sqrt(48) = 0.023 < 0.05.
no_retry: each campaign runs once into raw/<name>.jsonl (run.py refuses an existing file); an interrupted or failed campaign is reported, not rerun into the same name
